headline: Nifty rose while the *broader market ran ahead*
subline: Midcaps and smallcaps led the day. Fear fell hard.
hero_text: Nifty Smallcap 250 led. The broader market outran the frontline, with Midcap 150 up 1.48 percent.

why.title: Moody's lifted the growth view
why.desc: FY27 GDP forecast raised to 7 percent from 6 percent.

why.title: Crude and global yields eased
why.desc: Softer oil and a lower US 10 year improved appetite.

why.title: Participation was broad
why.desc: Metals and realty led. Midcaps and smallcaps outpaced.

why.title: The Tata cluster dragged
why.desc: A Tata Sons versus Tata Trusts dispute pulled Tata stocks down.

sector_reasons.Metal: Led the session as metals firmed
sector_reasons.Media: Held a strong bid all day
sector_reasons.Realty: Ran with metals among the leaders
sector_reasons.IT: Weakest sector on the TCS drag

bonus_text: Metals and realty carried the day. IT was the only real drag, held back by the Tata cluster.
movers_note_gainers: Adani names and Airtel led the pack.
movers_note_losers: TCS fell on the Tata Sons dispute.
watch_text: FII cash turned positive. But stock futures selling stayed on. More hedging than a clean turn.
lessons: Breadth backed the move. About 2 stocks rose for every 1 that fell.
The broader market led. Midcaps and smallcaps beat the frontline.
Fear fell fast. India VIX dropped 7.36 percent to 11.39.
One cluster can cap an index. The Tata drag held the Sensex flat.
alert_text: The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday 22 September.
cta_headline: A *broad up day*. Save it for the open.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Check back when the bell rings on Monday.
next_text: Monday 21 September opens the week. The Nifty weekly expiry lands Tuesday.
caption_a:
Nifty closed up 0.33% at 23,346 but the real story sat below the frontline.
Midcaps rose 1.48% and smallcaps 1.54%. Breadth ran 2 to 1.
Fear collapsed. India VIX fell 7.36% to 11.39.
FIIs turned buyers of Rs 599.5 Cr, breaking a selling run.
Watch: TCS and the Tata cluster capped the Sensex.

caption_b:
Moody's raised India's FY27 growth view to 7% from 6%. The market noticed.
Metals led at 1.51%, realty 1.19%, IT lagged at 1.03% down.
FII cash flipped positive at Rs 599.5 Cr. DIIs added Rs 1,019.7 Cr.
Nifty PCR sits at 1.12, max pain near 23,350, a balanced read.
